issues.title: workflow: the worktree reaper would delete LIVE lane worktrees — clean-and-merged cannot tell 'finished' from 'just started'

nodes.body:
**Shipped:** the reaper reads a LEADING liveness signal — git worktree lock from creation (lane_worktree.py creates-and-locks; git itself refuses to remove locked trees), a 120-min idle floor as backstop (admin index deliberately excluded — the reaper's own status probe rewrites it, which would make the floor unable to fail), main tree excluded by INODE never string · PR #3312 (merged 0c806b2de) · must-fail watched first: 5/6 new tests red on the pre-fix module, the key one exactly on the incident shape; live dry-run kept all five running lanes, named 7 long-merged trees reapable
**Outcome:** realized — a live lane in the checkout→first-write or push→merge window can no longer be judged finished; the clean-and-merged heuristic is demoted to a lagging co-signal

_source: gh api graphql — #3289 captured 2026-08-30; a clean close under the contract
